defect_observations.observation: The SRC-00907-00984 scope prints no source marker at the restored items; the 'Inherited source: Formal Logic, Version 1.0' line is emitted only for the eight reader-layout part IDs. A reader at Definitions 2.45-2.46 and Warning 2.47 (p.76) cannot see that they reproduce FLRV1. The attribution exists only remotely, in section 2.8 (w02-p01-019.tex 5-11 and 495-499). This is not a coverage failure, because the source blocks carry no attribution of their own, but the local attribution is weak.

There is an inactive editorial duplicate, \begin{hbwarning}{def:p01-direction-check}{Direction check}, whose wording is not the source's. No file on the main.tex route inputs formal-work-conventions.tex, and no credit was taken from it. If it is ever routed, it would duplicate Warning 2.47 with substitute wording.

The display numbers differ from the held source. Held PDF p.21 has section 2.3 with Definition 2.16, Definition 2.17 and Warning 2.18. The handbook build has section 2.5 with Definition 2.45, Definition 2.46 and Warning 2.47. The bounded blocks contain no \label, so no label is lost, but an external reference by source number would not resolve.

The provenance record gives disposition 'full transcription', and its content-token digest equals the artifact digest 2502779b...; this audit confirmed the match independently by comparing every line against source lines 907-984. The record still keeps handbook_destination.status 'open/missing' and every completeness dimension 'pending' because reviews are pending. That status is administrative and was not used as evidence either way.

The packet's owned_files do not exist, for example handbook/parts/p01/valuations-satisfaction-and-consequence-w02b-p01-010.tex and the matching annex, bib and registry intake files. The 6.7 host on the route is valuations-satisfaction-and-consequence-w02-p01-019.tex (p01.tex line 29).
